IgG4-related hypophysitis: Elevated IgG4 levels, pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass, and systemic imaging findings of a nodular lung lesion suggest IgG4-related disease.
Lymphocytic hypophysitis: Hypopituitarism, visual impairment, and pituitary MRI findings could also be consistent with lymphocytic hypophysitis, although the elevated IgG4 levels and systemic findings make IgG4-related hypophysitis more likely.
